review_question: Does the controlled record show explicit approval for B01 scope target and execution window?
pass_condition: Approver authority scope target and window are explicit and timestamped
fail_or_block_condition: Missing ambiguous expired or mismatched approval

review_question: Do target preflight host HTTPS health allowlist buildId and commit SHA reconcile?
pass_condition: All required preflight checks pass and deployed identity matches approved commit
fail_or_block_condition: Any failed check missing timestamp or build mismatch

review_question: Is the dataset approved synthetic versioned and reproducible?
pass_condition: Owner approval dataset ID/version and reset instructions are recorded
fail_or_block_condition: Missing approval version or reproducibility evidence

review_question: Does the dedicated test identity authenticate and match the approved role tenant and scope?
pass_condition: Successful target login and least-privilege mapping are evidenced without secrets
fail_or_block_condition: Authentication failure missing role mapping or scope mismatch

review_question: Can the authorized identity retrieve target audit evidence and required governed reports?
pass_condition: Timestamped retrieval references include query scope and outcome
fail_or_block_condition: Local-only output inaccessible target records or missing audit/report path

review_question: Are all six family smoke outcomes tied to the same target build and are persistence limits documented?
pass_condition: All required family checks are evidenced and durability/reset constraints reviewed
fail_or_block_condition: Missing family result build mismatch or unaccepted persistence limitation

review_question: Does each of 48 cases map to a requirement and controlled SRS/UAT case?
pass_condition: All 48 B01 requirements are accounted for with no orphan results
fail_or_block_condition: Missing case requirement mapping or uncovered requirement

review_question: Is observed actual business outcome captured independently of technical CI result?
pass_condition: Actual result is traceable to target execution evidence and expected/actual are distinct
fail_or_block_condition: Outcome inferred from CI/pilot or lacks target evidence

review_question: Are failures/blocked cases retained and retests linked to original defect and new build/session?
pass_condition: Every failure has disposition and retest references or remains open
fail_or_block_condition: Silent omission unresolved defect or unlinked retest

review_question: Is business acceptance recorded separately with authorized reviewer and timestamp?
fail_or_block_condition: Test PASS treated as acceptance or approval missing

review_question: Are artifact references timestamped versioned and integrity checked?
pass_condition: Manifest has artifact reference owner timestamp association and hash or equivalent integrity check
fail_or_block_condition: Missing artifacts stale references or unverifiable bundle integrity

review_question: Do reviewed B01 results reconcile to the 228-requirement master register without changing the baseline?
pass_condition: 48 B01 rows reconcile and all statuses match evidence
fail_or_block_condition: Count mismatch unsupported status change or baseline mutation
